req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent. To achieve high mutation kill rate we need: (1) a negative test confirming 401 on missing header with exact status code assertion, (2) a positive test confirming 200 with correct credentials to verify the comparison logic in check_basic_auth is not trivially broken, (3) a boundary test confirming the WWW-Authenticate header is present in the 401 response (the status_code helper sets it for 401), (4) a decision-table test covering the case where Authorization header is present but wrong credentials (still 401, different branch), and (5) a state-transition test verifying the authenticated/user payload on success. This covers both sides of the boolean in check_basic_auth (auth and auth.username==user and auth.password==passwd), the exact 401 constant, and the exact 200 constant.

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    data = r.get_data(as_text=True)
    assert 'authenticated' not in data.lower() or 'true' not in data.lower()

test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401()

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/myuser/mypass',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['authenticated'] == True
    assert body['user'] == 'myuser'

test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200()

import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_success_payload_exact_fields():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
    assert body['authenticated'] is True
    assert body['user'] == 'testuser'
